statusHistory.note: First issue of The Setlist, Near's monthly live-music column orchestrated by RUCIO LIBERO (BACKLOG.md EPIC 4 roster entry, now built — see lib/content/authors.ts and content/the-setlist.md for the full standing decision). Research done via the mandatory near-events skill first: Primavera Sound Sao Paulo's dates (5-6 Dec 2026, Autodromo de Interlagos) confirmed via musicfestivalwizard.com, wikimetal.com.br, and tenhomaisdiscosqueamigos.com (day-by-day lineup: Strokes/FKA twigs/Lily Allen/CMAT/Courtney Barnett on 5 Dec, Gorillaz/Arca/Yung Lean on 6 Dec) -- genuinely far-out and dated, per the site-wide 'further out is better' preference, ~3 months from publish. Also checked C6 Fest Sao Paulo (21-24 May 2026) but that date is already past as of this session's 2026-09-01 current date, so it was logged and dropped rather than used. Tied honestly to teatro-clube-da-eskyna-santos, a real Santos (Baixada Santista) nightlife-sound venue Near already covers, as the local-scene companion note -- the piece does not claim Interlagos acts play there, only that it is a real place to catch a show locally while planning the Sao Paulo trip. English copy complete, all six locales in progress. Held at status: draft pending a hero image.

Resolved the hero-image gate without near-illustrator generation (no image pipeline available this run): sourced a genuine, appropriately-licensed Wikimedia Commons photo of Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace (Interlagos) itself, the actual venue hosting Primavera Sound Sao Paulo -- strategy: stock, CC BY-SA 3.0, photographer Morio, attributed and linked per rules.md. Not AI-generated, so no illustration disclosure needed; still disclosed via normal stock attribution. All six locales (en, pt-BR, it, es-ES, es-419, zh-CN) written and validated against schema.ts's dek (max 160) and seoDescription (max 320) limits before this flip. Added to content/the-setlist-index.json's slugs array and content/the-setlist.md's Series Index, making the header nav's live-music link live for the first time.
